name: @researchos/dsh-researchos-server
description: ResearchOS fusion — consolidated server bundle that hosts all 11 business bundles (auth / project / folder / paper / file / writing / review / paper-card / export / settings / subscription) under a single /research-* API surface. Each sub-bundle is preserved as a separate sub-module under bundles/ so they keep their own top-level scope (avoids const/function collisions) and can be modified independently.
